headline: LSU looks to impose will against wounded Arizona State squad
subhead: The defending champ visits Tempe looking to stay unbeaten while Arizona State seeks redemption after Penn State blowout.

xFactor.why: Arizona State's secondary must tighten coverage downfield or LSU's passing attack will exploit the same weaknesses Penn State exposed.

keyMatchup: LSU's defensive line pressure versus Arizona State's ability to establish the run game early and control tempo.
body: LSU arrives in Tempe flush with confidence after dispatching Miami in a shootout where efficiency mattered more than total yards. The Tigers have the horses to execute both as a pass-heavy outfit and a ground-oriented unit, giving Mario Cristobal's defense multiple problems to solve. Arizona State, meanwhile, absorbed a 34-16 loss to Penn State that was closer to a beatdown than a tight contest, revealing coverage breakdowns and an inability to keep pace.

The Sun Devils have talent and schematic creativity, but Week 1 proved they cannot afford to fall behind early against elite programs. LSU's proven formula is to dictate line of scrimmage control and let playmakers operate in space, and Arizona State's front seven will need to generate immediate pressure to disrupt that rhythm. This is less about a clash of equals and more about whether Arizona State can avoid a second straight lopsided defeat.
